node.statement: Uniform compression and cross-extraction bounds. The compression estimate in def-compressed-corner gives a universal c_Co and threshold such that C_ij differs from each of X|->p_i(Xp_j) and X|->(p_iX)p_j by at most c_Co*(t+epsilon)<=2c_Co*t at every level; exact amplification and idempotence are supplied respectively by lem-compcb-amplified-compression and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. With ||p_i||<=2, the product axiom therefore gives ||C_ii||<=K_0 universally. If a_j=C_jj(a_j) and i!=j, substitute a_j=p_j(a_jp_j)+O(t)||a_j|| into p_i(a_jp_i), use the associator axiom a fixed three times to expose p_jp_i, and use node 1.1.1; this yields ||C_ii(a_j)||<=K_1*t||a_j||. Thus C_ii C_jj has norm at most K_1*t, while C_ii(a_i)=a_i exactly, and consequently ||C_ii(a_1+a_2)-a_i||<=K_1*t max(||a_1||,||a_2||). Taking K_geo=max{2,12,K_0,K_1} and the minimum of the universal thresholds proves node 1.1, uniformly in n.
